title: Compatibility of fixed cocycle-homology equivalences
statement: For any abelian-group cochain complexes K and L [lem-weil-pbc-object-resolution-cocycle-equivalence], a chain map f:K→L, a nonnegative degree q, and cycles x∈K^q and y∈L^q, if f^q(x)=y, then H^q(f) sends the actual cycle class of x to the actual cycle class of y. Cycle classes are constructed by the inclusion-of-cycles kernel isomorphism and the homology projection; no arbitrary additive equivalence is chosen. This is the chain-map naturality component of the Zariski–etale cocycle comparison, generalized to arbitrary complexes.

source.place: sites-cohomology.tex Section 01FT, equation-cohomology-object-site; derived.tex Tag 06XR (1), lemma-compute-ext-resolutions. The corresponding original .tex sections were fetched into the sandbox scratchpad and read.

proof.text: The inclusion of cycles is injective. Naturality cyclesMap(f)≫iCycles=iCycles≫f and f^q(x)=y imply that cyclesMap(f) sends the kernel lift of x to that of y. Apply naturality homologyπ≫homologyMap(f)=cyclesMap(f)≫homologyπ to obtain the displayed equality of cycle classes. All steps are proved in Lean with no remaining proof hole.

lean.statement:
theorem zariski_etale_resolution_cocycle_compatibility
    {K L : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ℕ} (f : K ⟶ L)
    (q : ℕ) (x : K.X q) (hx : (K.d q (q + 1)).hom x = 0)
    (y : L.X q) (hy : (L.d q (q + 1)).hom y = 0)
    (h : (f.f q).hom x = y) :
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f q).hom (sectionCycleClass K q x hx) =
      sectionCycleClass L q y hy
